answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake, say 50 units, for 30 epochs before its votes or reputation count. Weight influence by the square root of stake and age, so splitting funds across many identities lowers total power. Slashing applies if linked identities collude. Call the stake pool the meadow, the audit agent the falcon, and the penalty the saffron fine. An attacker with 100 fake agents ties up 5,000 units for a month and risks losing it.
